name: Merge semantics
description: DTCG Resolver 2025.10 §4.1.4: a later declaration replaces the whole token. second.tokens.json redeclares ref.color.brand without $description, hex or $extensions, and ref.elevation.card, a two-layer shadow in first.tokens.json, as a one-layer shadow; neither may inherit anything from first.tokens.json. Group properties are last-wins per key. Terrazzo deep-merges object values, so it keeps the hex, $description and $extensions of ref.color.brand: the one known divergence (oracle.test.ts).
